text: Every track now has a page.
All 458 tracks on the 39 albums link,
271 of them to new songs.
Every album song has a Spotify player,
351 have an official clip, and 421 link to their lyrics.
Step 1.
A script maps every track to its song,
once, and the album pages read that map.
Takes join their song: Billy 4 and Billy 7 are listed on Billy 1,
and Alberta's 2 takes became one song.
A live take with no page became a song under its plain title,
like Minstrel Boy.
And where Dylan co-wrote the words,
the song counts as his own.
One off-plan change: the new songs are in a file called album-tracks,
not tracks, because tracks was already taken by the Blood on the Tracks era.
Step 2.
Another writer's song names who wrote its words,
like Stardust, whose words are by Mitchell Parish.
A traditional song says just that:
a traditional song.
Off the plan: instrumentals keep their link to bobdylan.com,
as Nashville Skyline Rag already had.
The site lists a page for each,
though there are no words on it.
And no Genius links.
Genius answers this machine with an error,
and the search engines that could find its pages ask if it's a robot.
Rather than guess at addresses that might be dead,
there are none; you could add them by hand.
Step 3.
30 new connections reach the new songs,
12 of them famous covers.
If You See Her, Say Hello now leads to Girl from the North Country,
and it joins the Love gone wrong thread.
Off the plan: the threads are now kept by hand.
The script that built them would choose 10 new songs per theme and drop
the ones placed here, so it refuses to run without force.
Step 4.
Every row of every album is a link.
And a song page now names its live takes on other albums:
She Belongs to Me shows its Self Portrait take.
What ran: the data check, the build of 1,400 pages,
the phone check and the desktop check,
all passing, and the clip check.
Not done: Genius links, and checking every sentence of the new notes.
The rest of the choices are on this list:
the fetchers keep what they found,
the Saturday Night Live clip stays dropped,
and the cover versions stay out of their thread.
That's every track a page.
Seeing it run, anything you'd change?
